text:
Sara (PM): quick post-launch check — we've got a big mix of bug reports and enhancement asks from beta. I'd like to propose a focused 'stability' slice for the next 2 sprints: critical P0/P1 bugs + one UX enhancement per area. Thoughts?
Alex (Eng): +1 on P0/P1 focus. Is there a clear cut metric for 'UX enhancement' here? we should avoid scope creep.
Jin (Support): customer-impact list: #3421 (streaming regression), #3428 (embedding mismatch), #3435 (tokenization edge-case). Most are reproducible. Recommend triage block tomorrow.
Tara (Eng Lead): agree. Operational note — rerouting Dedicated capacity to hotfixes will reduce feature throughput. If we take that hit we should defer the model rollout.
Sara (PM): deferring rollout is ok if we bring embeddings/stability back to baseline. There's a small streaming fix Alex mentioned that might be low-risk.
Alex (Eng): streaming fix looks safe in staging. Plan: canary to 5% then 25% with metrics. Also we should add a perf smoke for KV cache slippage.
deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled for 2035004800 — will post logs to #eng-runtime.
Jin (Support): add a regression-alert to Redwood Optimize tied to the streaming promptset so we get early signal. Also ping the pilot customers for quick verification after canary.
Sara (PM): action items: 1) triage sesh tomorrow 10:00 (calendar invite sent), 2) commit ~30% dev capacity for P0/P1 for two sprints, 3) pick up to 3 enhancements (max 1 per area) to include in this slice. I'll update the roadmap PRD and link it here after the triage.
Tara (Eng Lead): quick question on acceptance: what's the launch criteria for calling this stability slice 'done'? SLA + no regressions window?
Sara (PM): proposed criteria: SLA latency & error rate back to baseline, zero P0s for 72h post-canary, and pilot customer sign-off on the affected flows.
Alex (Eng): also add a cost delta for the canary in the PRD and a dashboard spike check (tokens/sec, tail-latency) before we promote.
Sara (PM): noted. I'll add those to PRD. Thanks everyone — closing thread for now. :thumbsup:
